Return whether two strings contain the same characters with the same multiplicities. Spaces and letter case are significant.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    "aabc",
    "caba"
  ],
  "expected": true
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    "Ab",
    "ab"
  ],
  "expected": false
}
Hint

Compare character counts.
